data.name: Muhaffiz
data.gender_notes: Muhaffiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'hafaza' which means 'to protect, guard, preserve'. Muhaffiz is a name of respect and admiration given to individuals who are known for their protective and guardian-like qualities. The name Muhaffiz carries the meaning “Guardian, Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhaffiz usually hope their child will grow to embody guardian, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of protection and guidance from Allah.
data.etymology: Muhaffiz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guardian, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muhaffiz total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: محفظ
in_arabic.meaning: الله جو محفوظ کرنے والا ہے، حفاظت کرنے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: محفظ (Muhaffiz) اللہ کی صفت ہے جو اپنے عباد کی حفاظت کرنے والا ہے۔ یہ نام عربی زبان میں 'حفظ' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے 'حفاظت کرنا' یا 'محفوظ کرنا'۔ قرآن مجید میں اللہ کی صفات کے حوالے سے مختلف آیات میں 'حافظ' اور 'حفظ' کے الفاظ استعمال ہوئے ہیں، جیسے کہ 'و هو على كل شئ حفيظ' (الأنعام: ١٢٠)۔ محفظ نام رکھنے کا مطلب ہے کہ اللہ کی حفاظت اور نگہداشت حاصل ہوتی ہے۔

in_urdu.name: محفظ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ جو محفوظ کرنے والا ہے، حفاظت کرنے والا، نگهبان
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام محفظ (Muhaffiz) عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'حفظ' سے بنا ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں 'محفوظ کرنا' یا 'حفاظت کرنا'۔ اردو زبان میں اس نام کا استعمال اللہ کی صفات کے طور پر ہوتا ہے جو اپنے عباد کی حفاظت کرتا ہے۔ محفظ نام کا انتخاب کرنے کا مطلب ہے کہ والدین اپنے بچے کے لیے اللہ کی حفاظت اور نگہداشت کی دعا کر رہے ہیں۔ تاریخی طور پر، یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے کیونکہ یہ اللہ کی صفات میں سے ایک کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मुहाफिज़
in_hindi.meaning: भगवान जो सुरक्षित रखने वाला है, रक्षक
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुहाफिज़ (Muhaffiz) नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'सुरक्षित रखना' या 'रक्षा करना'। इस्लामी परंपरा में, यह नाम अल्लाह की विशेषताओं में से एक है, जो अपने अनुयायियों की रक्षा करता है। मुहाफिज़ नाम रखने का अर्थ है कि माता-पिता अपने बच्चे के लिए अल्लाह की सुरक्षा और संरक्षण की प्रार्थना कर रहे हैं। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम पारंपरिक और धार्मिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: محافظ
in_pashto.meaning: الله چې د خپلو بندګانو ساتونکی دی
in_pashto.long_meaning: د محفظ (Muhaffiz) نوم معنا دا دی چې الله چې د خپلو بندګانو ساتونکی او محفوظ کوونکی دی. دا نوم د عربي کلمې 'حفظ' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چي معنی يې ده 'ساتنه' يا 'محفوظ ساتنه'. په پښتو کلتور کې، دا نوم د الهي حفاظت او مراقبت د مفهوم په توګه کارول کېږي. په افغانستان کې، دا نوم دود دی چې ماشومانو ته د الهي نصرت او حفاظت د ترلاسه کولو لپاره ورکړل شي.

in_english.name: Muhaffiz
in_english.meaning: One who protects, preserves, or safeguards
in_english.long_meaning: Muhaffiz is derived from the Arabic root 'ḥ-f-ẓ,' which means 'to protect' or 'to preserve.' In Islamic tradition, Muhaffiz is an attribute of Allah, signifying the divine protector and guardian. The name implies a sense of safety, security, and divine care. Historically, the term 'Muhaffiz' has been used in various Islamic contexts to emphasize Allah's role as a protector. The name is popular across Muslim cultures, symbolizing the hope for divine protection and preservation.

data.cultural_impact: In Islamic culture, the name Muhaffiz holds deep respect and reverence, often given as a name for individuals who have shown exceptional protective qualities, such as parents, teachers, or protectors of the community. The name represents a sense of security, trust, and reliance, much like the Angel Mihail (Michael) who is believed to protect and guard Muslims during their struggle.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Muhaffiz carries a deeper meaning as it embodies the Islamic value of protection and guardianship. Muslims believe that every person is allocated two angels, one on each shoulder, who act as protectors, written in the Hadith by the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). Therefore, the name Muhaffiz resonates with the concept of being a 'protector' or 'guardian' on a spiritual level, and as such, it can serve as a constant reminder of our role in protecting and safeguarding the faith and morals of ourselves and those around us.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Hajar al-Haytami writes in his book 'al-Fatawa al-Hadithah fi Sifat al-Qiyamah' about the hadith which mentions the term 'Muhaffiz' in relation to the Angel of Death, who is tasked with recording the deeds of every soul. This hadith is classified as authentic (sahih) in the Hadith sciences and is narrated by several prominent companions of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh).
historical_references.time_period: Early Islamic Period, around 15th century AD

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun, in his seminal work 'The Muqaddimah', describes the institution of the 'Muhaffiz' in the context of pre-Islamic Arabian tribal societies. He notes that the Muhaffiz was a trusted guardian or protector, often appointed to oversee the collection and distribution of resources or to ensure compliance with tribal laws. This concept later influenced the role of the Shari'a judge (Qadi) in Islamic society, as a protector of the community's moral and legal order.
historical_references.time_period: Pre-Islamic and Early Islamic Periods, around 14th century AD

modern_usage.modern_context: In modern context, the Islamic name 'Muhaffiz' (guardian or protector) has been adopted by several technology companies to offer security solutions. It is particularly popular in the areas of technology security, digital privacy, and cybersecurity. Some well-known platforms using this name include Malwarebytes Muhaffiz, Muhaffiz for Android, and Muhaffiz for Windows.
